title: Unlocking Decoding-time Controllability: Gradient-Free Multi-Objective Alignment with Contrastive Prompts

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the Spearman's rank correlation coefficient (rho) between the helpfulness reward value and the generated response length to evaluate if the reward model disproportionately favors longer responses (verbosity bias).

Implicitly evaluated as a component of the broader 'Harmlessness' alignment objective using scalar reward models on the HH-RLHF and SafeRLHF datasets. The mitigation is guided by an expert prompt explicitly instructing the language model to 'steer clear of racism, ageism, and sexism'.
